headline: Trump Reveals Who Is Behind Attack on Key Saudi Oil Pipeline
summary: US President Donald Trump said Iran is most likely responsible for attacks on oil pipelines in Saudi Arabia. The statement was made on the same day as the report.
why: Saudi Arabia is among the world's largest crude exporters, so attacks on its pipeline network directly affect oil flows to global markets.
why_moved: Pipeline attacks in Saudi Arabia attributed to Iran raise supply concerns for crude oil.
